text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen from its early value and had sizable monthly swings without trades, so I should favor capital preservation and a risk level suited to retirement.","I should assess each stock and my overall allocation on their merits, rather than reacting to recent prices or letting my average cost dictate a trade.","I have traded infrequently; I should continue making deliberate decisions, maintain adequate cash for living needs, and avoid rushed trades after losses."]}
